run_eval_on_checkpoint: run the ByteLatent evaluation pipeline on a consolidated model checkpoint with PPL and lm-eval tasks
eval_ppl_on_path: evaluate perplexity and bits per byte on a dataset path using distributed data iterators and a loaded model
create_eval_harness_lm: create an EvalHarnessLM wrapper around a PackedCausalTransformerGenerator to integrate with the lm-eval harness
generate_until_with_harness: generate text completions from prompts using EvalHarnessLM with temperature, top_p, top_k, and until stop sequences
compute_loglikelihood: compute log-likelihood scores for prompt-continuation pairs using EvalHarnessLM for evaluation metrics
